title: Germany Study Visa Pakistan 2026 — APS, Blocked Account, Fees & Process | SK Immigration
description: Germany study visa from Pakistan: APS, blocked account, documents, fees, timeline, Ausbildung vs degree, refusal traps and FAQ. SK Immigration Services, Rawalpindi. No visa guarantees.

faqs.question: What are the main requirements for a Germany study visa from Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Admission or Ausbildung contract, funding proof (often blocked account), passport, academics, insurance, language evidence matching your pathway, and APS/attestation when your case requires it. SK Immigration builds a case-specific checklist.

faqs.question: Do Pakistani students need APS for Germany?
faqs.answer: Many degree pathways from Pakistan require APS (Akademische Prüfstelle) certificate review before or alongside university admission. Rules and queues change — verify current APS Pakistan guidance and do not book a visa slot until the APS step for your pathway is clear.

faqs.question: How much blocked account do I need?
faqs.answer: The required Sperrkonto amount changes. Always verify current embassy / Make-it-in-Germany guidance before opening an account. Ausbildung applicants usually show salary via the training contract instead of a classic student blocked account.

faqs.question: How long does a Germany student visa take from Pakistan?
faqs.answer: Often 4–7 months from shortlist to decision. APS queues, language gaps, peak winter intakes and incomplete funding proofs take longer.

faqs.question: Do I need German language for a degree taught in English?
faqs.answer: Not always for admission, but daily life and part-time work are easier with German. Ausbildung almost always needs German (often A2–B1+, higher for nursing).

faqs.question: What does SK Immigration charge?
faqs.answer: Student packages from PKR 50,000 for preparation. Embassy, blocked account, APS, university and insurance fees are separate. No visa outcome guarantees.

faqs.question: Do you guarantee the visa?
faqs.answer: No. German missions decide. We prepare complete, honest files and explain risks clearly. Verify us on /about/ (CUIN 0304985).

body:
Why Pakistani students choose Germany

Public universities often charge low or no tuition for degree programmes, while living costs are planned through a blocked account (Sperrkonto). Many applicants also compare full degrees with Ausbildung (earn-while-you-train). The right path depends on marks, language and career goal — not agent promises.

Study vs Ausbildung — pick honestly

  • Degree / Master: admission letter, funding proof, often English or German programme rules
  • Ausbildung: training contract + German language (often A2–B1+, higher for nursing)
  • Red flag: anyone selling a “guaranteed German visa” without a real university or employer

Requirements (Pakistan applicants)

  • University admission or Ausbildung contract from a recognized German institution
  • Proof of funds (blocked account amount changes — verify current embassy guidance)
  • Passport valid 6+ months, biometric photos, completed national visa forms
  • Academic transcripts and certificates (attestation / APS where your case requires it)
  • Health insurance meeting German entry rules
  • Language proof matching the programme or employer (German and/or English)

Step-by-step process from Pakistan

  1. Free profile review — study vs Ausbildung, budget and language reality
  2. Shortlist universities or Ausbildung employers; prepare CV / motivation letter
  3. Secure admission or training contract
  4. Open / confirm blocked account or other accepted funding proof
  5. Package documents, book appointment, attend biometrics / interview
  6. Track decision and prepare travel / enrolment

Documents checklist

  • Passport and photos
  • Admission letter or Ausbildung contract
  • Academic certificates and transcripts
  • Blocked account confirmation or equivalent funds proof
  • SOP / motivation letter and CV
  • Insurance and visa fee receipt
  • APS or attestation papers when required for your nationality / pathway

Interactive checklist: Open Germany checklist →

Fees (what you actually budget)

Plan for: German embassy/VFS visa fee + blocked account living funds + insurance + translations/attestation where needed. SK Immigration student packages start from PKR 50,000 for preparation support. Official fees are paid to universities and authorities — not to “guarantee” a stamp.

Timeline from Rawalpindi / WhatsApp clients

Many files take 4–7 months from shortlist to decision. Language training, APS queues, peak winter intakes and incomplete funding proofs add time. We sequence the file so you do not book an appointment with half-ready documents.

Common mistakes we see from Pakistan

  • Wrong blocked-account amount or provider for the visa category
  • Motivation letters that copy templates and do not match the programme
  • Ignoring German language needs for Ausbildung / nursing
  • Unattested academics when the mission asks for legalization
  • Confusing a visit visa with a student/national visa pathway

Related answers & guides

Germany student visa guide · Blocked account · Step-by-step apply · What is Ausbildung? · Germany work permit

APS, blocked account and language — the three decisions

Most Pakistan degree files stall on sequencing, not on “luck.” Confirm whether your pathway needs APS, which funding proof the mission currently accepts (often a blocked account / Sperrkonto for classic study), and whether your programme needs German, English, or both. Ausbildung files usually rest on a training contract + German level — not a student blocked account.
